name: webgpu-fly
description: Realtime LIF simulation of the FlyWire whole-brain connectome on WebGPU.

scripts.build:slim: npm run build && rm -rf dist/flybody dist/brain.bin dist/brain.meta.json dist/vnc.bin dist/vnc.meta.json dist/walking-policy.bin dist/walking-policy-fixtures.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build:slim && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=webgpu-fly --branch=main
